hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white

typography.pairing_archetype: The Old Money Tech / Fine Dining (Classic Serif Head + Clean Sans Body)

colors.contrast_rules: Maintain WCAG AA (min 4.5:1). Dark backgrounds with off-white text. Primary brand colors (terracotta/orange) used sparingly for CTAs, active states, and borders.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05) or rgba(200,75,49,0.2) for active elements
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero images must have bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0A] via-[#0A0A0A]/60 to-transparent
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture overlay on the main background to prevent flat black spaces

grids.bento_strategy: MODE A (The 'Tetris' Grid) for the About & Ambience sections. Asymmetrical 12-column grid. Wide gaps (gap-6 or gap-8).
grids.menu_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 with gap-8. Menu items shouldn't be enclosed in rigid white cards. Use transparent containers with subtle bottom borders.

layouts.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing: py-20 lg:py-32 for sections. px-6 lg:px-12 for containers.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text like menu descriptions. Center-align hero and major section headers.

motion.scroll: Use Framer Motion for smooth, staggered fade-up entrances for menu items.
motion.hover: Hovering on menu items slightly translates X (translate-x-2) and changes text color to accent.
motion.buttons: Hover states must scale slightly (scale-105) and increase shadow glow.

accessibility.contrast: Text over images must use explicit text shadows or dark gradients.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='reservation-submit').

media.images_handling: Max 80vh on mobile. Use object-cover for all grid images.
media.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5 for a premium, delicate look.

3d_libraries.usage: Not strictly necessary for this scope, but a subtle framer-motion parallax on the hero image is recommended to increase perceived value.

hero.description: High-end cinematic shot of an Indian Thali on a dark background, perfect for the hero section.

about_chef.description: Chef cooking with high flames in a dark, moody kitchen for the About Section.

menu_south_indian.description: Artistic presentation of Dosa on a dark background for the South Indian menu section.

menu_north_indian.description: Rich Indian curries on dark background.

ambiance_2.description: Lit windows and moody foliage, used to frame ambiance or contact sections.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `npm install lucide-react framer-motion sonner` or `yarn add` equivalent.
Update tailwind.config.js to set font-families (sans -> Manrope, serif -> Playfair Display) and the deep color palette.
Build a one-page scrolling architecture. The Header should be fixed, using Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/50 border-b border-white/5).
Implement Shadcn Form for the Reservation Inquiry. Customize inputs to fit the dark theme (bg-white/5, border-white/10, text-white, placeholder-white/40).
Avoid using standard rigid 'Cards' for menu items. Use text-based lists with price dots/dashes, or cardless grids. Menu items should have high-end restaurant typography.
In the Hero section, overlay the image heavily so 'Muthuraj Naati Mane' and 'Family Dining at Its Best' are completely legible without straining.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and form inputs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use generic centered text everywhere. Use alignment to create tension.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Use specific transitions like transition-colors or transition-transform.
Do not use transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath (use backdrop-blur).
Always apply hover, active, and focus states.
Never use AI placeholders like emojis 🤖💭 for icons. Strictly use Lucide React icons.
Never use via.placeholder.com. ONLY use the image URLs provided.
Ensure padding inside containers prevents text from touching borders.
